data.summary: Beispiel Versand GmbH invoiced €134.98 for a cordless hedge trimmer and shipping, ordered on account on 15 December 2025. Payment is due 7 days after the invoice date of 17 December 2025.
data.explanation: This is a normal invoice for an online purchase on account (Kauf auf Rechnung). Pay €134.98 to the bank account printed on the invoice and use the invoice number BV-7741203 as the payment reference. The payment term is 7 days after the invoice date, with no deduction. If you don't pay on time, the seller may send a reminder and possibly add fees. Keep the invoice as proof of purchase and for the warranty.
